about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of a determined 1980s journalist tasked with a simple assignment: photograph a quiet forest trail in the early morning. Armed only with a camera and a walkie-talkie, you venture into dense trees, rocky paths, and a serene lake while your boyfriend stays behind in the camper van.

What begins as a routine job quickly turns tense and unsettling. Discover scattered documents and mysterious tape recorders left by a retired scientist. Each tape uncovers secrets of the forest, guiding you deeper into the wilderness and closer to danger.

The forest is alive with eerie phenomena: distorted audio over your walkie-talkie, sudden noises, birds bursting from the trees, and shadows that seem to watch your every move. Collect photographs of wildlife, strange occurrences, and other unsettling sights while navigating a tense, rocky relationship with your boyfriend, whose guidance over the walkie-talkie can comfort or frustrate you.

Hidden collectibles, like three elusive ducks, unlock a fun Easter egg, referencing a previous adventure. But the forest holds darker threats. The deeper you go, the closer you come to a monstrous presence, culminating in a chilling and unforgettable climax.

Key Features:

  • Atmospheric first-person horror adventure set in a vast 1980s forest.

  • Photography-based gameplay: capture wildlife, clues, and eerie occurrences.

  • Explore the forest while discovering tapes that reveal hidden stories.

  • Tense, immersive audio design with distorted walkie-talkie communication.

  • Subtle collectibles and Easter eggs for players who explore carefully.

  • A story-driven experience with psychological and jump-scare elements.

Experience Shutter — a haunting journey through nature, narrative, and fear, where every photograph could be your last.
